title: RefSiblingValuesDraft7
description: Through draft 7 a $ref replaces everything written beside it, which is the rule #118 applied to `type`. The enum arm of each of the three ladders that turn a schema into a Go type ran ahead of their ref arms, so a const, an enum or an empty enum beside a $ref decided the type and the reference was never followed: "abc" was rejected at every position although the draft admits it, which is over-enforcement -- a document refused for a keyword that is not there to be read. The target still applies, which is what "ab" pins. One position per ladder: a property is resolvePropertyType, an element and a map value are resolveType, and a definitions entry reached through a $ref is generateTypeDef.
